_comment: v5.0 pure catalog-driven library. No premium pool (subjects/extra/visual_anchors removed). Each tag has catalog_subjects + catalog_env_partners + template_group. Default image count = len(catalog_subjects) x --cards-per-subject.
critical_note: CFG is near 1.0 on distilled Turbo models, so NEGATIVE prompts barely work. All constraints are written positively. Never use the words 'jigsaw puzzle' or 'puzzle pieces' in a prompt - some models then draw cut lines into the artwork.
quality_suffix: deep depth of field, consistent sharpness across the whole image, depth conveyed through scale, overlap and perspective rather than optical blur, clean uncluttered composition with clear visual hierarchy, medium-scale readable details, vibrant saturated colors, clear visual landmarks with meaningful differences in shape, color and scale between regions, rich texture variation continuing into all four corners, no large flat empty areas, no excessive sky or water, no repetitive micro textures, full-bleed artwork

viewpoint: detailed near view with full depth of field
atmosphere: earthy warm tones with vivid accents
